```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Setup: load packages and set options
```

```{r}
# Load data
# Load the dataset
# Use read_csv or read.csv — read_csv returns a tibble (nice for dplyr).
# Read raw lines as latin1 (won't fail on bytes)
#lines <- readLines("National Wellbeing Survey Public Use Data.csv", encoding = "latin1", warn = FALSE)

# Convert to UTF 8, replacing undecodable bytes with "?" (or "" to drop them)
#lines_utf8 <- iconv(lines, from = "latin1", to = "UTF-8", sub = "?")

# Save a new UTF 8 file and then read it normally
#writeLines(lines_utf8, "National Wellbeing_Survey_utf8.csv", useBytes = TRUE)
#data_frame <- read_csv("National Wellbeing_Survey_utf8.csv") 

data_frame <- readr::read_csv("National Wellbeing Survey Public Use Data.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))

# Filter to target population: U.S. adults ages 18 to 64
df <- data_frame %>%
  # ensure AGE numeric; if stored as character, coerce
  mutate(AGE = as.numeric(AGE),
         SEX = as.numeric(SEX)) %>%         
  filter(SEX %in% c(1,2))   %>%
  #keep male, female responses
  filter(
    HAPPY != 99,
    if_all(c(MEANING, SAT1, SAT2, SAT3, SAT4, SAT5),
           ~ !.x %in% c(98, 99)))
  

# Quick sanity check: sample size after filtering
n_observations <- nrow(df)
cat("Unweighted N after filtering to SEX 1/2/4:", n_observations, "\n")


```


```{r}
# 1. Define ADL variables for convenience
diff_vars <- c("DIFF_CHAIR","DIFF_DRESS","DIFF_SHOWER","DIFF_EAT","DIFF_TOILET")

# 3. Create ADL_group with robust row wise logic, and turn into a factor with desired order
# Define ADL group categories, without recoding 98/99
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ADL_group = case_when(
      # All five == 1
      DIFF_CHAIR == 1 & DIFF_DRESS == 1 & DIFF_SHOWER == 1 &
      DIFF_EAT == 1   & DIFF_TOILET == 1 ~ "No ADL Limitations",

      # At least one == 2, and none == 3
      (DIFF_CHAIR == 2 | DIFF_DRESS == 2 | DIFF_SHOWER == 2 |
       DIFF_EAT == 2   | DIFF_TOILET == 2) &
      !(DIFF_CHAIR == 3 | DIFF_DRESS == 3 | DIFF_SHOWER == 3 |
        DIFF_EAT == 3   | DIFF_TOILET == 3) ~ "Some ADL Limitations",

      # At least one == 3
      DIFF_CHAIR == 3 | DIFF_DRESS == 3 | DIFF_SHOWER == 3 |
      DIFF_EAT == 3   | DIFF_TOILET == 3 ~ "A lot of ADL Limitations",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ADL_group = factor(ADL_group,
                       levels = c("Some ADL Limitations",
                                  "A lot of ADL Limitations"))
  )

# Quick check: rows sum to assigned_count
cat("Final unweighted N:", nrow(df), "\n")
table(df$ADL_group, useNA = "ifany")

```

```{r}
# Recode other variables
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    HAPPY2 = case_when(
      HAPPY %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Very/rather happy",
      HAPPY %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Not very/not at all happy"
    ),
    MEANING2 = case_when(
      MEANING %in% c(4, 5) ~ "Somewhat/Strongly Agree",
      MEANING %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "Disagree/Neutral"
    ),
    EMO_SUPPORT = case_when(
      LISTEN %in% c(1, 2) ~ "A great deal/Some",
      LISTEN %in% c(3, 4) ~ "A little/Not at all"
    ),
    loan_bin = ifelse(LOAN == 1, 1, 0),
    live_bin = ifelse(PLACE_LIVE == 1, 1, 0)
    ,
    
    support_sum = loan_bin + live_bin,
    INSTRU_SUPPORT = case_when(
      support_sum == 0 ~ "No instrumental support",
      support_sum == 1 ~ "Low instrumental support",
      support_sum == 2 ~ "High instrumental support",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
    
    ,
    
    SEX = case_when(
      SEX == 1 ~ "Male",
      SEX == 2 ~ "Female",
      SEX == 3 ~ "Non binary",
      SEX == 4 ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    SEX = factor(SEX, levels = c("Male", "Female", "Non binary", "Other"))
    
    
    ,
    RACE_ETH = case_when(
      RACEREC ==1 ~ "Non Hispanic White",
      RACEREC == 4 ~ "Hispanic",
      RACEREC ==2 ~ "Non Hispanic Black",
      RACEREC %in% c(3,5,6) ~ "Other races"
    ),
    MARITAL3 = case_when(
      MARSTAT %in% c(1, 6) ~ "Married/member of an unmarried couple",
      MARSTAT %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ "Divorced/separated/widowed",
      MARSTAT == 5 ~ "Single, never married"
    ),
    EDUC2 = case_when(
      EDUC %in% c(5, 6) ~ "Bachelor's or higher",
      EDUC %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4) ~ "No college degree"
    ),
    INCOME2 = case_when(
      HHINC %in% 4:12 ~ "More than $40,000 a year",
      HHINC %in% 1:3 ~ "Less than $40,000 a year"
    ),
    LIFE_SATIS = rowMeans(across(c(SAT1, SAT2, SAT3, SAT4, SAT5)), na.rm = TRUE),
    OVERWEIGHT = case_when(
      OVERWEIGHT %in% c(1) ~ "Overweight",
      OVERWEIGHT %in% c(2) ~ "Not Overweight"
    ),
    HIGH_BP = case_when(
      HIGH_BP %in% c(1) ~ "Has High Blood Pressure",
      HIGH_BP %in% c(2) ~ "No High Blood Pressure" 
    ),
    DIABETES = case_when(
      DIABETES %in% c(1) ~ "Has Diabetes",
      DIABETES %in% c(2) ~ "No Diabetes"
    ),
    HEART = case_when(
      HEART %in% c(1) ~ "Has Heart Issues",
      HEART %in% c(2) ~ "No Heart Issues"
    ),
    COPD = case_when(
      COPD %in% c(1) ~ "Has COPD",
      COPD %in% c(2) ~ "No COPD"
    ),
    SMOKER = case_when(
      SMOKER %in% c(1) ~ "Never Smoked",
      SMOKER %in% c(2) ~ "Former Smoker",
      SMOKER %in% c(3,4) ~ "Current Smoker"
    ),
    PA_STRENGTH = case_when(
      PA_STRENGTH %in% c(1,2,3) ~ "Infrequent/No Strength Based Exercise",
      PA_STRENGTH %in% c(4,5) ~ "Frequent Strength Based Exercise"
    ),
    PA_FLEX = case_when(
      PA_FLEX %in% c(1,2,3) ~ "Infrequent/No Flexibility Based Exercise",
      PA_FLEX %in% c(4,5) ~ "Frequent Flexibility Based Exercise"
    ),
    COV_IMP = case_when(
      COV_IMP %in% c(1,3) ~ "COVID did not have a positive impact",
      COV_IMP %in% c(2) ~ "COVID had a positive impact"
    ),
    SLEEP3_clean = case_when(
      SLEEP3 %in% c(1,2,3) ~ "Poor Sleep Quality",
      SLEEP3 %in% c(4,5) ~ "Good Sleep Quality",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


```


```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    HAPPY2 = factor(HAPPY2, 
                    levels = c("Not very/not at all happy", "Very/rather happy")),
    INSTRU_SUPPORT = factor(INSTRU_SUPPORT,
                            levels = c("No instrumental support", "Low instrumental support", "High instrumental support")
      
    ),
    MEANING2 = factor(MEANING2, levels = c("Disagree/Neutral","Somewhat/Strongly Agree")),
    EMO_SUPPORT = factor(EMO_SUPPORT, levels = c("A little/Not at all","A great deal/Some")),
    RACE_ETH = factor(RACE_ETH, levels = c("Non Hispanic White","Hispanic","Non Hispanic Black","Other races")),
    MARITAL3 = factor(MARITAL3, levels = c("Married/member of an unmarried couple","Divorced/separated/widowed","Single, never married")),
    EDUC2 = factor(EDUC2, levels = c("No college degree","Bachelor's or higher")),
    INCOME2 = factor(INCOME2, levels = c("Less than $40,000 a year","More than $40,000 a year")),
    OVERWEIGHT = factor(OVERWEIGHT, levels = c("Overweight","Not Overweight")),
    HIGH_BP = factor(HIGH_BP, levels = c("Has High Blood Pressure","No High Blood Pressure")),
    DIABETES = factor(DIABETES, levels = c("Has Diabetes", "No Diabetes")),
    HEART = factor(HEART, levels = c("Has Heart Issues", "No Heart Issues")),
    COPD = factor(COPD, levels = c("Has COPD", "No COPD")),
    SMOKER = factor(SMOKER, levels = c("Current Smoker","Never Smoked", "Former Smoker")),
    PA_STRENGTH = factor(PA_STRENGTH, levels = c("Infrequent/No Strength Based Exercise","Frequent Strength Based Exercise")),
    PA_FLEX = factor(PA_FLEX, levels = c("Infrequent/No Flexibility Based Exercise","Frequent Flexibility Based Exercise")),
    COV_IMP = factor(COV_IMP, levels = c("COVID did not have a positive impact", "COVID had a positive impact")),
    SLEEP3_clean = factor(SLEEP3_clean, levels = c("Poor Sleep Quality", "Good Sleep Quality"))
  )
```

Conduct Logistic Regression

Restrict Sample to Individuals with Poor Self Reported Mental Health

```{r, warning=FALSE}
df_sub1 <- df %>%
  filter(
    MENT_HEALTH %in% c(4, 5),
    ADL_group %in% c("Some ADL Limitations", "A lot of ADL Limitations")
  )
```

Create Survey design
```{r, warning=FALSE}
df_sub1 <- df_sub1 %>%
  mutate(MEANING3 = factor(MEANING2))

survey_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~FINAL_WGT,
  data = df_sub1
)
```

Model 1: ADL only base models

Unadjusted models: Individual predictors

Emotional Support
Hedonic Wellbeing
```{r, warning=FALSE}
mdl1_happy_emo <- svyglm(
  HAPPY2 ~ EMO_SUPPORT,
  design = survey_design,
  family = binomial()
)

exp(cbind(OR = coef(mdl1_happy_emo), confint(mdl1_happy_emo)))
```
Eudaimonic Wellbeing
```{r, warning=FALSE}
mdl1_meaning_emo <- svyglm(
  MEANING3 ~ EMO_SUPPORT,
  design = survey_design,
  family = binomial()

exp(cbind(OR = coef(mdl1_meaning_emo), confint(mdl1_meaning_emo)))
```

Model 2: Fully Adjusted Models
FUlly Adjusted Hedonic wellbeing Model
```{r, warning=FALSE}
mdl2_happy_full <- svyglm(
  HAPPY2 ~
    EMO_SUPPORT + INSTRU_SUPPORT +
    AGE + SEX + RACE_ETH + MARITAL3 + EDUC2 +
    SMOKER + HIGH_BP + DIABETES + HEART + COPD +
    OVERWEIGHT + INCOME2 + COV_IMP + SLEEP3_clean +
    PA_STRENGTH + PA_FLEX,
  design = survey_design,
  family = binomial()
)

exp(cbind(OR = coef(mdl2_happy_full), confint(mdl2_happy_full)))

```

Summary of Adjusted Happiness Model that shows p-values
```{r}
summary(mdl2_happy_full)
```

Fully Adjusted Eudaimonic Wellbeing Model
```{r, warning=FALSE}
mdl2_meaning_full <- svyglm(
  MEANING3 ~
    EMO_SUPPORT + INSTRU_SUPPORT +
    AGE + SEX + RACE_ETH + MARITAL3 + EDUC2 +
    SMOKER + HIGH_BP + DIABETES + HEART + COPD +
    OVERWEIGHT + INCOME2 + COV_IMP + SLEEP3_clean +
    PA_STRENGTH + PA_FLEX,
  design = survey_design,
  family = binomial()
)

exp(cbind(OR = coef(mdl2_meaning_full), confint(mdl2_meaning_full)))

```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
collect_1 <- function(models){
  OR = round(exp(coef(models)), digits = 2)
  CI = round(exp(confint(models)), digits = 2)
  return(data.frame(OR=OR, CI=CI)[-1,])
}

dataframes_1 <-lapply(happy_list_unadj, collect_1)
tmp <- c()
for(k in 1:length(dataframes_1)){
  tmp <- rbind(tmp, dataframes_1[[k]])
}
```

Descriptive Statistics Table
```{r}
# Build descriptive table 
my_table <- survey_design %>%
  tbl_svysummary(
    by = ADL_group,
    missing = "no",
    include = c(
      HAPPY2, MEANING3, LIFE_SATIS, EMO_SUPPORT, INSTRU_SUPPORT,
      SEX, AGE, RACE_ETH, MARITAL3, EDUC2, INCOME2,
      HH_ADULTS, HH_CHILDREN, OVERWEIGHT, HIGH_BP,
      DIABETES, HEART, COPD, SMOKER, COV_IMP
    ),
    percent = "column",
    statistic = list(
      all_categorical() ~ "{p}%",
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({mean.std.error})"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 2,   # round mean & SE to 2 decimal places
      all_categorical() ~ 2
    ),
    label = list(
      LIFE_SATIS ~ "Life satisfaction",
      HAPPY2 ~ "Happiness",
      MEANING3 ~ "Life has meaning",
      EMO_SUPPORT ~ "Emotional support",
      INSTRU_SUPPORT ~ "Instrumental Support",
      SEX ~ "Sex",
      AGE ~ "Age",
      RACE_ETH ~ "Race/ethnicity",
      MARITAL3 ~ "Marital status",
      EDUC2 ~ "Education",
      INCOME2 ~ "Household income",
      HH_ADULTS ~ "Adults in household",
      HH_CHILDREN ~ "Children in household",
      OVERWEIGHT ~ "Overweight",
      HIGH_BP ~ "High blood pressure",
      DIABETES ~ "Diabetes",
      HEART ~ "Heart condition",
      COPD ~ "COPD",
      SMOKER ~ "Smoking Status",
      COV_IMP ~ "Global COVID 19 impact on life"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_overall() %>%

 modify_header(stat_0 ~ glue("Overall (n = {overall_n})")) %>% 
modify_header(
    stat_1 ~ glue("Some ADL Limitations (n = {unweighted_ns_vec['Some ADL Limitations']})"),
    stat_2 ~ glue("A lot of ADL Limitations (n = {unweighted_ns_vec['A lot of ADL Limitations']})")
  )  %>%
  
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::pct(70),    # scale table 
    data_row.padding = gt::px(1),  # reduce row padding
    table.font.size = 6           # shrink font size
    
    
  ) 


#  Print the table 

my_table
```

Graphs and Plots

```{r}
library(survey)
library(dplyr)
#Create New Dataframe
# Define ADL group categories, without recoding 98/99
df2 <- data_frame %>%
  mutate(
    ADL_group = case_when(
      # All five == 1
      DIFF_CHAIR == 1 & DIFF_DRESS == 1 & DIFF_SHOWER == 1 &
      DIFF_EAT == 1   & DIFF_TOILET == 1 ~ "No ADL Limitations",

      # At least one == 2, and none == 3
      (DIFF_CHAIR == 2 | DIFF_DRESS == 2 | DIFF_SHOWER == 2 |
       DIFF_EAT == 2   | DIFF_TOILET == 2) &
      !(DIFF_CHAIR == 3 | DIFF_DRESS == 3 | DIFF_SHOWER == 3 |
        DIFF_EAT == 3   | DIFF_TOILET == 3) ~ "Some ADL Limitations",

      # At least one == 3
      DIFF_CHAIR == 3 | DIFF_DRESS == 3 | DIFF_SHOWER == 3 |
      DIFF_EAT == 3   | DIFF_TOILET == 3 ~ "A lot of ADL Limitations",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ADL_group3 = factor(ADL_group,
                       levels = c("No ADL Limitations","Some ADL Limitations",
                                  "A lot of ADL Limitations")),
    HAPPY2 = case_when(
      HAPPY %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Very/rather happy",
      HAPPY %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Not very/not at all happy"
    ),
    MEANING2 = case_when(
      MEANING %in% c(4, 5) ~ "Somewhat/Strongly Agree",
      MEANING %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "Disagree/Neutral"
    )
    
  )


# Create Survey Design for N=3775
survey_design2 <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~FINAL_WGT,
  data = df2
)


```

```{r}

# Get weighted proportions for each level of HAPPY2 within ADL_group
happy_prop <- svyby(
  ~ HAPPY2,                # factor variable
  ~ ADL_group3,             # grouping variable
  survey_design2,
  svymean,
  vartype = "se",
  na.rm = TRUE
) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```


```{r}
library(tidyr)

happy_long <- happy_prop %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("HAPPY2"),
    names_to = "HAPPY2_level",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    HAPPY2_level = gsub("HAPPY2", "", HAPPY2_level),  # extract level number
    HAPPY2_level = factor(HAPPY2_level, levels = levels(survey_design$variables$HAPPY2))
  )

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(happy_long, aes(x = ADL_group3, y = proportion, fill = HAPPY2_level)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +       # 100% stacked bars
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Happiness Levels by ADL Group",
    x = "ADL Group",
    y = "Percent",
    fill = "Happiness Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
  )

```

```{r}
ggsave("HappyPlot.png", plot = last_plot(), bg = "white")
```

Forest Plots for ORs and their CIs
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

df_long <- tmp2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(UOR, ULCL, UUCL, AOR, ALCL, AUCL),
    names_to = c("Model", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.)(.+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(Model, "U" = "Unadjusted", "A" = "Adjusted")
  )

```

```{r}
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = OR, y = Predictors, color = Model)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = LCL, xmax = UCL),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Odds Ratio",
    y = "",
    title = "UOR and AOR for Happiness",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

```

```{r}
ggsave("HappyORs.png", plot = last_plot(), bg = "white")
```
